why: Real Mi-8 / Mi-17 flight deck (Mi-8AMTSh, photographs and the model's own frame lines): the windscreen is two large flat armoured panes (one in front of each pilot) meeting at a slim centre post, each with its own wiper; a flat side-front pane sits between the corner pillar and the pillar in front of the sliding side window; the roof carries a flat eyebrow window over each side window. The sliding side windows are bulged (blisters) and the chin windows follow the curved nose skin, so those are NOT listed. UNVERIFIED against a photograph taken from the same angle: the layout is the one the model's own pillars and posts give, with its centre gap closed by one post on the centre line.
